name: @konxyz/kon-relay
description: Helia + libp2p daemon that exposes a local Helia blockstore (the one publish:* writes to) to the public IPFS network. Without this daemon, blocks pinned via KON_PIN_SERVICE=helia are not fetchable from public gateways like w3s.link or .limo — they live only in the local filesystem. kon-relay closes that loop by speaking libp2p Bitswap over TCP and announcing CIDs to the public DHT.
